title: Telecommunications (Licencing Classification) (Amendment) Notice, 2002 | No. 3 of 2003
text:
SAINT VINCENT AND THE GRENADINES
STATUTORY RULES AND ORDER
2003 NO. 3
_______________________________
GAZETTED 21st January, 2003
_______________________________
IN EXERCISE of the powers conferred on him by section 5 (3) of the
Telecommunications Act, 2001 (No. 1 of 2001) the Minister, on recommendation from
ECTEL, gives the following Notice:
TELECOMMUNICATIONS (LICENCE CLASSIFICATION) (AMENDMENT)
NOTICE, 2002
Citation 1. These Regulations may be cited as the
Telecommunications (Licence Classification) (Amendment) Notice,
2002.
Amendment of 3. Subsections (1) and (2) of section 3 of the
section 3 of No. Telecommunications (Licence Classification) Notice, 2002
14 of 2002
hereinafter referred to as “the principal Notice” are deleted
and the following substituted:

Services 4. (1) The following telecommunications services are
under the classified under an individual licence:
licence
(a) Public Mobile Telecommunications;
(b) Fixed Public Telecommunications;
(c) Submarine Cable;
(d) Public Radio Paging; and
(e) Internet Networks/Services
(2) The following telecommunications services are
classified under a class licence:
(a) Internet Services Provision (5 <= 15 units);
(b) Internet Services Provision (> 15 units);
(c) Value Added Services;
(d) Private Networks/Services;
(e) Audio Text / Video Text;
(f) International Simple Voice Resale;
(g) Subscriber Television;
(h) Television Broadcast;
(i) Radio Broadcast;
(j) Community Radio;
(k) Short Term;
(l) Land Mobile;
(m) Maritime Mobile;
(n) Aeronautical Mobile;
(o) Amateur Radio;
(p) Citizen Band Radio;
(q) Ship Station;
(r) Family Radio.”
Amendment of 3. Subsection (3) of section 5 of the principal Notice is repealed and
section 5 of replaced by the following:
principal
